mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the service hatch was most worthwhile: it showed why the controls and counterweight needed to remain accessible after skinning the whale.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the skin was straightforward, with little explanation at that point of how it fit around the workings.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; the chapter supplied a clear assembly order and the remaining parts had recognizable purposes.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the whale and its fair work together. This chapter was mostly straightforward assembly, but the accessible controls and stop gave the construction a practical purpose.
